title: Sarah Baartman
summary: Sarah Baartman was an indigenous Khoikhoi woman taken from South Africa in 1810 and exhibited across Britain and France as a freak show spectacle under the derogatory name "Hottentot Venus." Following her death in Paris in 1815, her body was dissected and her remains were kept in a Paris museum. After prolonged diplomatic appeals initiated by Nelson Mandela, the French parliament voted to repatriate her remains, which were returned and buried with state honors in South Africa in 2002.

uncertainty.note: Born c. 1789 in the Gamtoos Valley; died in Paris in 1815; remains repatriated and buried in 2002.
